Question Choices: If a shape is 5 square decimeters, how many square centimeters is that?
Solution: 1 decimeter = 100 square centimeters. 5 decimeters × 100 square centimeters each = 500 square centimeters

Question Choices: Shape C has 30 square units. Shape D has 25 square units. Which shape covers more space? : C D
Solution: 30 > 25 So Shape C has larger area

Question Choices: If a shape has 6 square decimeters, how many square centimeters is that?
Solution: 1 decimeter = 100 square centimeters. 6 × 100 = 600. So the area is 600 square centimeters

Question Choices: The same square can be measured as 25 square centimeters. It can also be measured as 1 square decimeter if the unit is larger. Does this mean one measurement is wrong? : Yes No
Hints: The square stayed the same size.
Solution: The square is still the same size. Only the unit used to measure it changed.

Question Choices: A shape is covered by 7 unit squares. What is its area? : 1-square-units 7-square-units 14-square-units
Solution: 7-square-units -> Area = number of unit squares covering the shape.
